name: app-69dd680fdb748191ad028d499c2328a9
description: Search current YachtWorld boats and yachts for sale worldwide.

interface.longDescription: Search, compare and research boats and yachts for sale worldwide using current YachtWorld marketplace inventory. Find listings by make, model, location, price, size, year, condition, engines, equipment and cabins, see photos and asking prices, open a listing's full details, and research how many boats are available and current asking-price ranges. YachtWorld is strongest for global and international inventory, broker-represented boats, yachts and larger vessels.
defaultPrompt: Show me motor yachts in Miami
Show me boats listed in the last 7 days

positive.description: Search listings by boat type and location
positive.prompt: Show me motor yachts in Miami
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current YachtWorld motor yacht listings near Miami with photos, asking prices and listing links.
Returns current YachtWorld sailboat listings longer than 50 feet.

positive.prompt: Show me boats listed in the last 7 days
positive.expected_behavior: Returns YachtWorld listings listed in the last 7 days.

positive.prompt: How many sailboats are available under $200k?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many sailboats are listed under $200,000 with the asking-price range, without showing a list of boats.

positive.prompt: Show me trawlers under $300,000, then show me the details for the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Lists trawlers under $300,000, then shows the first listing's details, photos and specifications.
